# `prepaid_command`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Durable internal prepaid command journal; no runtime dispatcher or public API yet. Request and completed result are retained.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  | Stable command UUID; shares the funding-command advisory lock identity. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Owning billing account; additional transfer participants belong to the immutable request. |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  | Internal order, renewal or transfer command kind, not a TMF enum. |
| `due_date` | `date` | no |  | Immutable due business date; never a daily billing-run anchor. |
| `request` | `jsonb` | no |  | Immutable checked quote/request document; money is encoded with exact Decimal JSON. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Injected-clock acceptance instant. |
| `state` | `text` | no | `'pending'::text` | Internal pending, completed or failedTechnical recovery state. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` | Number of committed success or technical-failure decisions, retained across manual retries. |
| `attempted_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Injected-clock last recorded decision instant. |
| `next_retry_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Technical retry eligibility; one minute, five minutes, then hourly. |
| `result` | `jsonb` | yes |  | Immutable committed result, written in the same transaction as financial effects and events. |
| `error` | `text` | yes |  | Last technical failure reason; business refusals belong in the completed result. |
